issue.title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?

summary.text: The request proposes adding Cloudflare Workers’ Flask deployment guide to Flask’s “Hosting Platforms” documentation. A maintainer indicated that the addition is acceptable and invited the author to open a PR, while separately asking that Cloudflare be shown the Pallets donation page without implying any promised service or link in return.

known_facts.text: The reporter supplied a Cloudflare guide for deploying Flask applications on Workers and requested a link from Flask’s hosting documentation.
After a maintainer noted that the guide’s referenced example was missing, the reporter stated that it had been merged and was now available.
The maintainer expressed concern that company-submitted hosting links can resemble advertising, but considered Cloudflare comparable in scale to platforms already listed.
The maintainer ultimately invited the reporter to open a PR and asked them to pass along the Pallets donation link, explicitly without promising any particular service.

similar_issues.reason: Both issues propose small updates to Flask deployment-related documentation and mention Cloudflare, but they request different changes: #4245 concerns changing Cherokee links from HTTP to HTTPS because its site supports TLS through Cloudflare, whereas #6146 seeks to list Cloudflare Workers as a Flask hosting platform.
similarities: Both concern links in Flask deployment or hosting documentation.
Both mention Cloudflare in connection with deployment infrastructure.
differences: The target requests adding a Cloudflare Workers Flask deployment-guide link to the Hosting Platforms section.
Issue #4245 requests changing existing Cherokee documentation links from HTTP to HTTPS.
Issue #4245 concerns Cherokee’s website and Cloudflare certificates, not deploying Flask applications on Cloudflare Workers.

draft_reply: Thanks for following up and for adding the referenced example to the Cloudflare repository. Given the discussion above, adding the Cloudflare Workers Flask guide to the Hosting Platforms documentation is acceptable. Please open a focused PR with the link, following the existing format for that section. Separately, please pass the Pallets donation page to the appropriate team at Cloudflare; as noted above, that is not tied to any promised service or documentation placement. Would you be able to open the PR?
